items.heading: Lap Lap
details: Key ingredients: grated root vegetables, coconut cream, banana leaf
Grate root vegetables such as taro, yam or cassava.
Mix the grated vegetables with coconut cream.
Wrap the mixture in banana leaves.
Bake in an earth oven or regular oven until set and tender.

items.heading: Coconut Crab Vanuatu
details: Key ingredients: coconut crab, coconut milk, onion
Clean and prepare fresh coconut crab.
Saute onion until soft.
Simmer the crab in coconut milk with the onion.
Cook until the crab is tender and serve with rice or taro.

items.heading: Coconut Crab
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
